notes.title: V0.1.4.4 Hotfixes
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Xp drop rate from enemies increased to 100% to reduce uncertainty in gameplay and accelerate player growth[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3][list]
[*] Pistol and Sword initial damage stats increased
[*] Stat points needed to acquire new device increased[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed a stat display bug for Shell(Item) 
[*] Fixed a stat display bug for Sword(Weapon) 
[*] Fixed an occasional game pausing bug after exiting the System Upgrade state[/list]
[h3]Misc[/h3][list]
[*] Little modification on UI & sound effect[/list]

notes.title: V0.1.4 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Features[/h3][list]
[*] New System Ugrade options: Smithy, Shop, and Bank are now available as System Upgrade options[list]
[*] Smithy: Players can allocate stat points to upgrade acquired devices
[*] Shop: Players can acquire items and new devices with stat points
[*] Bank: Players can invest all remaining stat points for potentially higher return [/list][*] Charge Indicator UI: Added an UI that displays remaing charges for Weapon and Special right next to player[list]
[*] Charge UI is toggleable from options. (Options -> GameEffect -> Charge UI)[/list][/list]
[h3]Removed[/h3][list]
[*] The move speed penalty has been completely removed[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Level up & Victory state animations have been modified
[*] Enemy projectiles made visible in darkness
[*] Asteroid indicator visible in darkness has been added
[*] Xp bar has been relocated to the bottom of the screen and increased in size.[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3][list]
[*] Initial stats for weapons have been buffed
[*] Enemy move speed has been slightly increased
[*] The minimum distance between enemy spawn and the player position has been increased[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Replaced expired Discord server link to a valid one
[*] Fixed occasional game pausing after using the "Retry" button
[*] Fixed game pausing after Ichor ray upgrade.
[*] Fixed toggle between auto/manual being ignored occasionally
[*] Fixed enemy sliding upon entering the System Upgrade state[/list]

notes.title: Midnight Heaven Broadcast
notes.notes:
[b]Midnight Heaven[/b] will be broadcasting for this Steam Next Fest! 

Please share your feedback, suggestions, and questions! 
The dev would greatly appreciate your candid thoughts on Midnight Heaven. 
The game is in its early stages of development, and many updates are planned in the near future. Player feedbacks at this stage will have a significant impact on shaping Midnight Heaven.

[b][url=https://discord.gg/xcUjVZ26vQ]Discord[/url][/b] 
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2358090]Steam Community Hub[/url][/b] 
[b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf04-Hnua7Odi_vVXLD3uaClIpMQ7jsTKlZbxtEG8spOD5FeQ/viewform?usp=sf_link ]Google Form[/url][/b]

notes.title: V0.1.2 Update
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Changes[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Added a 'don't show this message again' checkbox on messages 
[*] Added an experimental option to remove the move speed penalty.
[list]
[*] By default, move speed penalty is applied during weapon firing. Turning off the 'Move speed penalty' option allows you to remove this feature. 
[*] The option can be found in Options->Experimentals->Move speed penalty[/list][*]Added a 'Recycle' button to the System Upgrade(Level up). This feature allows players to convert XP into gems instead of leveling up.  
[*] Enabled access to the 'Upgrade Center' upon Stage Clear. 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]The First Demo of Midnight Heaven Is Now live![/b] 

The demo will remain accessible to any players and be updated for more than a month. During this period, I will do my best to apply player's feedback and suggestions. 
 
Player opinions are really valuable, especially in this early stage of development. Please feel free to use either [url=https://discord.gg/xcUjVZ26vQ]Discord[/url] or a [url=docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf04-Hnua7Odi_vVXLD3uaClIpMQ7jsTKlZbxtEG8spOD5FeQ/viewform]Google form[/url] to communicate your opinion. 

Sincerely, Urge Engine
